body: Note: this PR's issue now carries `P?` (paused by the maintainer). Per AGENTS.md this branch takes no further work from agents: it stays a draft, is not flagged ready, and gets no more pushes until the maintainer sets a priority. Nothing in it has been posted to or merged.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/app/src/posting.rs: main's per-setup skip_stops afters plus the #530 family-door loop: keep both sides). Targeted gate: clippy -D warnings (app, ui, post) clean; app edm_machine, machine, machine_library pass; post crate pass; ui lib machine pass. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merged main to resolve conflicts (post machine/def.rs Kind moved to kind.rs - EDM variants ported there; mod.rs, parse.rs, app machine/draft.rs, machine/validate.rs, posting.rs, ui panes.rs, assets/machines/AGENTS.md: keep both sides; also added the EDM kinds to the Machines pane kind combo and updated plasma_machine's kind-message assert). Targeted gate: edm_machine 7, machine 33, plasma_machine 6, machine_edit 12, machine_library 11, posting 17, machine_assign 3, camcraft-post all, ui machine lib tests 31: green; clippy -D warnings post/app/ui lib+tests clean. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
Quick pass: mergeable with main, body complete (Changelog, Fixes/Refs, Not exercised), quick gate green at this head e3cf0f12 (post, app and ui suites, 0 failed). Flagging ready for review.

Back to draft: its issue (#530/#531) is labelled `P?` - the maintainer paused the EDM foundation on 2026-11-09, so this waits for the maintainer to set a priority. Readying it was a mistake on our side; the branch is current with main and gated green, nothing else changes.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/post/src/machine/def.rs, mod.rs: keep both sides; edm field beside spindle_mount/default_holder, parse_mch_with export kept). Targeted gate: edm_machine and plasma_machine suites ok, camcraft-post tests ok, clippy -p camcraft-post/app/ui --lib --tests -D warnings clean. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

The maintainer has opened EDM for work (2026-11-12): #530 is `P1` and no longer paused, and your claim is recorded. This PR is the base of the whole wire slice, so it is first in the review queue as soon as it is flagged ready (gate green on a head that merges with current main). #532 will be worked stacked on #560.

Quick pass (M5): the EDM issues were unpaused (P? → P1), so this PR comes off hold. It merges cleanly with main; its last refresh (a merge of main, conflicts kept both sides) was gated green on its targeted suites (edm_machine, plasma_machine, edm_conditions, camcraft-post, clippy). The body has Changelog and Fixes. Flagged ready for an independent review. Note: upstream's #532 worker is stacked on #560 → #551, so these merge first, parent first (#551, then #560).

**Needs changes before merge** - the dangerous direction holds (no mill/lathe op posts on an EDM on any entry point I could find), but the `edm` section is read leniently where the bar for this section is "refused by name, never ignored".

Reviewed at b262e79f, trial-merged locally with main a0891091 (clean, no conflicts; never pushed).

### What looks good
- `Kind::WireEdm` / `Kind::SinkerEdm` are declared only. Every exhaustive `match` on the machine kind now has a deliberate EDM arm (`post_serves`, `required_by_kind`, `MachineDraft::blank`, the editor combo, `panes::icon_of`). `Family::admits` is a `matches!` over admitted pairs, so EDM falls to "not admitted" without a wildcard.
- The post-time family gate in `op_streams` (`crates/app/src/posting.rs` ~L805) is the right seam. All three engine calls (`post_script_body`, `posting_mounts`, `posting_per_op`) go through `op_streams`, so the GUI, MCP `post`, the script `post()` verb, one-setup and per-mount posting all hit it. A local probe confirmed it on a **setup that owns its EDM machine** (`SetSetupMachine` on Setup1, document following): `post_mounts`, `post_setup` and `op_streams` all refuse with `Face1: a Face operation cannot run on its setup's wire EDM machine - ...`.
- The one wildcard left, `default_post_for` (`_ => PostRef::Builtin`, i.e. Fanuc mill, for an EDM), cannot reach metal: `post_offer` drops it because `post_serves(_, EDM)` is false, and the family gate refuses every op. An empty program is refused anyway (`no operations to post`). Not blocking, but an explicit EDM arm there would make the intent obvious.
- Shipped machines are unchanged: `edm` is `skip_serializing_if = None` and absent sections parse to `None`. Every NC/dialect suite listed below passes unchanged.
- Clean-room: the templates are empty synthetic fixtures (`"edm": {}`, vendor "Camcraft"). The provenance line and the `assets/machines/AGENTS.md` text are our own. No PNG changes, no new dependency, decision file present, `Changelog:` + `Fixes #530` present.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (lib 16, axis_direction_cli 3, comp 9, comp_plane 3, mch_head_search 2, post_engine 33) | pass |
| app `edm_machine` 7, `plasma_machine` 6 | pass |
| app NC/post suites: conformance 6, golden_cl 25, solid_law_goldens 2, posting 17, fanuc_post 11, tormach_post 10, carvera_post 4, doosan_dnm_post 7, heidenhain_cycles 11, inverted_post 15, probe_dialects 13, post_unit_word 5, plasma_post 5, setup_mounts_post 6, setup_post_options 3, post_not_judged 10 | pass |
| app machine/lathe suites: machine 33, machine_library 11, machine_edit 12, machine_key_order 2, tormach_machines 6, tormach_lathes 10, machine_assign 4, lathe_post 7, lathe_post_g76 8, lathe_post_refusals 6, lathe_post_tormach 7, lathe_post_tormach_thread 7, lathe_stroke 1 | pass |
| `camcraft-ui --lib machine` 32, `--lib structural` 4 (CWD crates/ui) | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Probe results, all against `parse_mch` on the wire template:
```
{ "max_taper": 95 }                         -> Ok, edm all None (typo read as "not stated")
{ "wire_diam": [-1] }                       -> Ok, edm all None
3axis-vmc.mch + { "max_taper_deg": 10 }     -> Ok, a MILL carries edm.max_taper_deg = 10
wire_edm + { "orbits": [circular O1] }      -> Ok (a sinker key on a wire is accepted without a word)
wire_edm head with spindle 12000 + Flood M8 -> parse Ok, validate_text = [] (no refusal)
inch file, { "lower_guide_z": 1e308, "wire_diameters": [1e308] } -> Ok with lower_guide_z = inf, wire = inf (is_sane() = false)
"Die Sinker EDM" -> None (refused, fine); "EDM" / "wire" -> None (good: ambiguous)
100 000 wire diameters -> Ok, no hang
```

### Requested before merge
1. **Unknown keys in `edm` are silently ignored** - `crates/post/src/machine/edm.rs`, `parse_edm`. A misspelt key (`max_taper`, `wire_diam`, and in #560 the condition keys) reads as "not stated" with no diagnostic. Today that fails safe (an op that needs the value refuses later), but the refusal then names the key the user believes they wrote. Please refuse any key outside the known set by name: `machine file: edm.max_taper is not an edm key (lower_guide_z, upper_guide_z, ...)`.
2. **An `edm` section on a non-EDM kind is accepted** - `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` ~L229 ("a mill that states one carries it inertly"). Please refuse it by name (`machine file: edm: only a wire_edm or sinker_edm machine states an edm section`). Also refuse wire-only keys (`lower_guide_z`, `upper_guide_z`, `max_taper_deg`, `wire_diameters`, `awt`) on a sinker, and sinker-only keys (`orbits`, `max_orbit_radius`, `pickup`) on a wire. Right now a wire file's `orbits` passes the door and lands in a struct a wire op will never read. A file that says one thing and is read as another is the misleading case.
3. **An EDM machine that states a spindle or coolant passes both doors** - `crates/app/src/machine/validate.rs` `required_by_kind` ~L382 has the plasma rule (`no spindle, coolant or rotary`, pinned by `a_plasma_file_stating_a_spindle_is_refused_by_name`) but no EDM equivalent. `MachineDraft::blank` already leaves them out for EDM, so the editor's own law and the reader disagree. Please refuse a spindle / tool_station coolant on `wire_edm` / `sinker_edm` by name, as plasma does.
4. **Finite before scaling, not after** - `edm.rs` `num()` and the `wire_diameters` loop check `is_finite()` on the raw number, then multiply by the inch factor, so `1e308` in an inch file is accepted as `inf` mm. `LoadMachine` / `SetSetupMachine` catch it later via `is_sane()`, but only as the unnamed "machine states a limit that cannot be meant". Please check the scaled value, or bound the lengths, so the refusal names `edm.lower_guide_z`.
5. **Cohesion: put the parser's tests in camcraft-post** - every `parse_edm` / `Kind::from_word` / `is_sane` test lives in `crates/app/tests/edm_machine.rs`; `camcraft-post` has none (its lib still runs 16 tests). Please move the pure parser cases (`a_garbled_edm_section_refuses_the_file_by_name`, the kind words, and the new refusals above) into a `crates/post/src/machine/edm_tests.rs` (like `tooling_tests.rs`), and keep the app suite for the posting gate and the project round trip.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The post-time family gate is a behaviour change for existing projects as well: a milling op left on a setup later remounted on a lathe now refuses at post where it used to post in the mill dialect. That is the right call under the Prime Directive, and no shipped suite regressed. It is worth a line in the changelog row ("...and on a lathe").
- Reverse direction (an EDM op on a mill): no EDM op family exists yet, so it is untestable here. When #533/#542 add `Family::Wire` / `Family::Sinker`, `admits` must list only `(Wire, WireEdm)` / `(Sinker, SinkerEdm)`, and a test like `an_edm_op_remounted_onto_a_mill_is_refused_at_post` should pin it.
- `default_post_for` keeps a `_ =>` arm. An explicit `Kind::WireEdm | Kind::SinkerEdm => PostRef::Builtin` with a "#533: no EDM post yet; post_serves refuses it" comment would make the next added kind a compile error instead of a silent Fanuc default.
- Duplicate keys (`"max_taper_deg": 95, "max_taper_deg": 10`) read last-wins. That is serde_json's behaviour across the whole `.mch` reader, not this PR's.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` (1243 lines) grows by 20 and `crates/post/src/machine/parse.rs` is now 402. A small `posting_family.rs` for the gate would keep both from growing.
- Not exercised: the GUI machine editor round trip of a filled `edm` section (only `machine_edit` suites, no EDM case), and the MCP `post` tool end to end (covered by code path only: it calls the same `op_streams`).

Merge order: this first, then #560 (stacked on it). Both are `feat` and merge at the next cut.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Review requests addressed at ebf0644b (upstream/main merged first, as a merge commit: fc08c7c2). Still a draft.

| # | Request | What changed | Pinned by |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Unknown `edm` keys silently ignored | `parse_edm` checks every key against the kind's list and refuses by name: `machine file: edm.max_taper is not an edm key (lower_guide_z, upper_guide_z, ...)`. An orbit entry's unknown key refuses too (`edm.orbits: radius is not an orbit key (kind, word)`). | `machine::edm::tests::an_unknown_edm_key_is_refused_by_name`, `a_garbled_edm_section_refuses_the_file_by_name` (post) |
| 2 | `edm` on a non-EDM kind; wrong-kind keys | `parse_edm` takes the declared kind. Any `edm` section on another kind, declared or inferred, refuses: `edm: only a wire_edm or sinker_edm machine states an edm section`. A wire key on a sinker and a sinker key on a wire refuse: `edm.orbits is a sinker_edm key; this is a wire_edm machine`. The parsed form keeps the same rules (`Edm::fits(kind)` and `Machine::edm_sane`, inside `is_sane`). | `an_edm_section_on_another_kind_or_with_the_other_kinds_keys_is_refused`, `the_parsed_machine_keeps_the_kind_rules` (post) |
| 3 | Spindle / coolant on an EDM | New `post::machine::edm_refusals`, the plasma rule's twin: a head `spindle.*`, a `live_tool`, a `tool_station.coolants` or `tooling.coolants` each refuse by name. Plasma and EDM now share one walk (`machine/no_spindle.rs`), so both doors read the same keys. The reader refuses at the declared-kind door (moved into `kind::declared_kind`, which also brings `parse.rs` back under 400 lines). `required_by_kind` lists them in the Machines pane. A rotary stays allowed on an EDM, since wire and sinker indexers exist. | `an_edm_stating_a_spindle_or_coolant_is_refused_by_name` (post), `edm_machine::the_machines_pane_lists_an_edm_spindle_and_coolant_by_name` (app) |
| 4 | Finite before scaling | `num()` and the `wire_diameters` loop scale first and then check finiteness, so an inch `1e308` refuses as `edm.lower_guide_z = 1e308 is out of range`. | `a_length_that_overflows_once_scaled_is_refused_by_name` (post) |
| 5 | Parser tests in camcraft-post | `crates/post/src/machine/edm_tests.rs` (`#[path]` module, like `tooling_tests.rs`) now holds the parser cases: the filled/scaled section, the garbled section, the kind words, plus the new refusals (7 tests; post lib 16 -> 24). The app suite `edm_machine` keeps the templates, the validator, the door and post-time family gates, and the round trip (7 -> 5). Total 7 -> 12. | - |

Notes taken:
- The changelog row now says "...or a milling op on a setup remounted on a lathe".
- `default_post_for` has no wildcard: `Kind::WireEdm \| Kind::SinkerEdm => PostRef::Builtin`, with the #533/#542 comment.
- The post-time family gate moved to `crates/app/src/posting_family.rs`. `posting.rs` is now 1238 lines (below main's 1243), and `parse.rs` is 379.
- Not done: duplicate JSON keys still read last-wins. That is serde_json's behaviour for the whole reader, not this section's.

Gate (local, macOS, merged with upstream/main): `cargo test -p camcraft-post` all pass (lib 24); app `edm_machine` 5, `plasma_machine` 6, `machine` 33, `machine_library` 11, `posting` 17 pass; `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. Not run: the ui suites (no ui file changed in this push).

Ready again: all five requested changes are addressed (see the comment above). reviewing @ ebf0644b (M5 reviewer, independent of the worker); the maintainer may want their own re-check of the needs-rework items.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (at the cut: `feat`). Every request from my review of b262e79f is fixed. I re-ran my original probes against the new head rather than relying on the table: each one now refuses by name, and nothing panics.

Re-reviewed at ebf0644b, judged on its fix commit (ebf0644b; fc08c7c2 is a merge of upstream main). Trial-merged locally with main 0fc30b65: clean, never pushed.

### Earlier requests: re-probed
| # | Request | Status | Probe result at ebf0644b |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Unknown `edm` keys ignored | **fixed** | `{ "max_taper": 95 }` -> `machine file: edm.max_taper is not an edm key (lower_guide_z, upper_guide_z, max_taper_deg, wire_diameters, awt)`; an orbit `radius` -> `edm.orbits: radius is not an orbit key (kind, word)` |
| 2 | `edm` on a non-EDM kind | **fixed** | 3axis-vmc + `edm` (even `{}`) -> `edm: only a wire_edm or sinker_edm machine states an edm section`; the same for an undeclared XYUV file. `"edm": null` on a mill still loads. |
| 3 | Sinker keys on a wire / the reverse | **fixed** | wire + `orbits` -> `edm.orbits is a sinker_edm key; this is a wire_edm machine`. The parsed form keeps the rule (`Edm::fits`, `Machine::edm_sane` inside `is_sane`). |
| 4 | Spindle / coolant on an EDM | **fixed** | wire head `spindle.max_speed` -> `machine file: spindle.max_speed: an EDM machine has no spindle - ...`; `spindle: {}` and `tooling.coolants` are refused by name too; `validate_text` lists both the spindle and the coolant. |
| 5 | inch `1e308` read as `inf` | **fixed** | `edm.lower_guide_z = 1e+308 is out of range` (now scaled before the finiteness check, in `num()` and in the `wire_diameters` loop) |
| - | Cohesion | **fixed** | `crates/post/src/machine/edm_tests.rs` (post lib 16 -> 24); the app suite keeps the posting gate and the round trip. |

### Not over-tightened
- Both fixtures load and pass `validate_text` with no refusals. So do a fully stated wire section (guides, taper, wires, AWT) and sinker section (orbit, radius, pickup).
- A wire with an A rotary still loads, as intended for an indexer.
- **Every machine in `posting::MACHINES` (30, plasma 1300PL and the mill-turn and lathes included) parses, is sane, and has zero `validate_text` refusals.** The plasma rules now share `no_spindle.rs`, and `plasma_machine` / `plasma_post_refusals` pass unchanged.
- The family gate at post (now `crates/app/src/posting_family.rs`) still refuses a Face on a setup-owned wire EDM through `post_mounts`, `post_setup` and `op_streams`.

### Local results (merged with main)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: every binary passes, including lib 24, post_engine 33, recorded_streams 11, cycle_hop 7, vendor_mch_cli 2, and all eleven `script_*` suites.
- app: edm_machine, plasma_machine, conformance, golden_cl, solid_law_goldens, posting, fanuc_post, tormach_post, carvera_post, doosan_dnm_post, heidenhain_cycles, inverted_post, probe_dialects, post_unit_word, plasma_post, plasma_post_refusals, setup_mounts_post, setup_post_options, machine, machine_library, machine_edit, machine_key_order, tormach_machines, tormach_lathes, lathe_post, lathe_post_refusals, machine_assign all pass, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-ui --lib machine` 32, `--lib structural` 7 (CWD crates/ui): pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- No `unwrap()`/`expect(`/`panic!` in `edm.rs`, `no_spindle.rs`, `kind.rs` or `posting_family.rs`. Files: `edm.rs` 286, `parse.rs` 379.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Duplicate JSON keys still read last-wins. That is the whole reader's serde_json behaviour, as you noted.
- `"Die Sinker EDM"` is not a synonym, so it refuses as an unknown kind. That is safe, just a missing word if you want it.

Merge order: this first, then #560. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
